items.name: c-emoji-picker-1
items.title: Inline emoji picker
items.description: The full picker inline on a card: search, category tabs, the grid and a footer with the preview and skin tone.
items.descriptionLong: Inline emoji picker. Built by composing Card, Emoji Picker. A free, open source shadcn emoji picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-emoji-picker-1 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-emoji-picker-2
items.title: Chat composer
items.description: A chat composer that inserts emoji at the caret and keeps the draft in view.
items.descriptionLong: Chat composer. Built by composing Avatar, Bubble, Button, Card, Emoji Picker and 3 more. A free, open source shadcn emoji picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-emoji-picker-2 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-emoji-picker-3
